INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

2. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information.

3. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

6. When practising Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

7. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

8. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

9. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening Comprehension.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 9.2.1 Extensive Reading: Dialogues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing: Apology Letter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
